description: Canonical registry of Formspec lint rule codes. Tested rules carry a normative spec pointer (specRef) and an imperative repair hint (suggestedFix) that the authoring loop surfaces to LLMs. Draft entries exist so every emitted code is discoverable — fill them in as rules graduate.

rules.title: Cannot determine document type
rules.suggestedFix: add a recognizable Formspec root (`items`, `components`, or `tokens`) so the document type can be detected

rules.title: Schema violation
rules.suggestedFix: align the document with schemas/*.schema.json — fix the flagged property or value

rules.title: Duplicate item key
rules.suggestedFix: rename one of the duplicate item keys — each `key` must be unique within its parent scope

rules.title: Duplicate item full path
rules.suggestedFix: remove the duplicate item at this path, or re-key one instance so full paths are unique

rules.title: Bind target not found
rules.suggestedFix: change bind target to match an item key, or add the missing item to `items`

rules.title: Shape target references unknown item
rules.suggestedFix: point the shape target at an existing item path, or add the referenced item to `items`

rules.title: Undefined option set reference
rules.suggestedFix: define the named option set under `optionSets`, or change the item's `optionSet` reference

rules.title: Incompatible dataType for optionSet
rules.suggestedFix: change dataType to one of string/integer/decimal/choice/multiChoice, or drop the optionSet

rules.title: FEL expression failed to parse
rules.suggestedFix: fix the FEL syntax to match the grammar — check operators, quotes, and path references

rules.title: Dependency cycle
rules.suggestedFix: break the dependency cycle — remove one bind's reference to the other

rules.title: Unresolved extension
rules.suggestedFix: declare the extension in a loaded registry, or remove the extension key

rules.title: Retired extension
rules.suggestedFix: stop using this retired extension — migrate to its replacement or remove the key

rules.title: Deprecated extension
rules.suggestedFix: plan migration away from this deprecated extension before it is retired

rules.title: Module-extensible enum value resolves no closed-core OR declared-module contribution
rules.suggestedFix: add the contributing module to the document's `modules[]` declaration, or change the value to a closed-core member of the enum

rules.title: Module contribution payload mismatches the contributing module's declared payload schema (MODULE-PAYLOAD-SCHEMA-MISMATCH)
rules.suggestedFix: align the consuming-document value to the contributing module's payload schema (widget.widgetShape.props, slot-type.slotShape, unit-kind.semantics, validation-mapping-row.row, or token-category.categoryShape); future module-contributed `Component.component: x-...` widget admittance gates through this pass per ADR 0150 §4.5 (deferred from Task 5)

rules.title: Component node id collides with another node in the bundle (COMP-BUNDLE-ID-COLLISION)
rules.suggestedFix: stamp bundle-unique ids by prefixing colliding ids with the owning Component document's stem (e.g. `headerLogo` in `dashboard.component.json` -> `dashboard.headerLogo`)

rules.title: Document module fails posture field-equality admission (POSTURE-MODULE-ADMISSION-DENIED)
rules.suggestedFix: change the document modules[] entry to match a posture allowedModules[] row, or widen the posture entry by omitting fields that should admit any document-side value

rules.title: Authoring actor URN is absent from posture.allowedActors[] (POSTURE-ACTOR-ADMISSION-DENIED)
rules.suggestedFix: add the actor URN to posture.allowedActors[] or change generatedBy/actor to an admitted AuthorActor id

rules.title: Surface route is not reachable from the entry route (SURFACE-ROUTE-UNREACHABLE)
rules.suggestedFix: add a transition from a reachable route, embed the unreachable route via an embed-route slot, or remove the unreachable route declaration

rules.title: Surface embed-route slot binding references a route that does not exist in this surface (SURFACE-SLOT-BINDING-UNRESOLVED)
rules.suggestedFix: change binding.routeRef to an existing route id in this surface's routes[], or add the missing route declaration

rules.title: Invalid color token value
rules.suggestedFix: use a valid CSS color (hex, rgb/rgba, hsl/hsla, or named color) for this color token

rules.title: Invalid size token value
rules.suggestedFix: use a valid CSS length with unit (px, rem, em, %, …) for this size token

rules.title: Invalid font weight token value
rules.suggestedFix: set font weight to a 100-step numeric (100…900) or a recognized keyword (normal, bold, …)

rules.title: Invalid duration or easing token value
rules.suggestedFix: use a valid duration (e.g. `200ms`) or an easing function (`ease-in`, `cubic-bezier(...)`)

rules.title: Unresolved token reference
rules.suggestedFix: define the token in your theme's tokens map, or use an existing token

rules.title: Theme item key not in paired definition
rules.suggestedFix: remove the `items` override, or add an item with this key to the paired definition

rules.title: Page region references unknown item key
rules.suggestedFix: change the region `key` to match an item path in the definition, or add that item

rules.title: Theme targetDefinition.url does not match paired definition
rules.suggestedFix: align `targetDefinition.url` with the definition's `url`, or pair with the correct definition

rules.title: Unknown non-extension token
rules.suggestedFix: rename the token to a known category, or namespace custom tokens under an `x-` prefix

rules.title: Platform token not declared
rules.suggestedFix: declare this token under `tokens` to set a project-specific default; otherwise the platform default applies — no action required

rules.title: Duplicate page id
rules.suggestedFix: rename one of the duplicate page IDs — each `pages[].id` must be unique

rules.title: Responsive breakpoint references unknown page region
rules.suggestedFix: declare the breakpoint under `theme.breakpoints`, or remove the unused `responsive` entry

rules.title: Theme widget is incompatible with definition dataType
rules.suggestedFix: choose a compatible widget, or set Select widgetConfig.multiple when targeting multiChoice fields

rules.title: Component tree root must be a layout component
rules.suggestedFix: wrap the root in a layout component (e.g. `Section`, `Stack`, `Grid`)

rules.title: Unknown built-in component
rules.suggestedFix: use a built-in component type, or define this type in `components` as a custom component

rules.title: Component incompatible with field dataType
rules.suggestedFix: pick a component whose matrix accepts this field's `dataType`, or change the field type

rules.title: Component requires options but field provides none
rules.suggestedFix: add `optionSet` or inline `options` to the bound field, or switch to a component that takes no options

rules.title: Formatted-variant TextInput must bind to string field
rules.suggestedFix: bind a formatted TextInput (variant: richtext, markdown, or latex) to a field whose dataType is string or text, or set variant back to plain

rules.title: Component and Theme assign a field to incompatible pages
rules.suggestedFix: align the Theme page region with the Component direct-root Section, or remove the shadowed Theme page layout

rules.title: Custom component instance missing required param
rules.suggestedFix: provide every parameter the custom component declares in its `params`, or remove the instance

rules.title: Custom component reference cycle
rules.suggestedFix: break the custom-component cycle — a component must not transitively reference itself

rules.title: Theme pages shadowed by Component page structure
rules.suggestedFix: remove Theme pages when the Component tree owns page Sections, or keep them only as inactive authoring hints

rules.title: Unsupported Component responsive override property
rules.suggestedFix: move structural changes out of responsive overrides, or use a prop allowed for that component in specs/ui-policy.json

rules.title: Component and Theme breakpoint values differ
rules.suggestedFix: make same-name Theme and Component breakpoints use the same pixel value, or rename one breakpoint

rules.title: Component bind does not resolve to a field
rules.suggestedFix: point bind at an existing field key, or add that field to the definition

rules.title: Layout/container component should not declare a bind
rules.suggestedFix: remove `bind` from layout/container components — only input components bind to fields

rules.title: Component compatibility warning (loose match)
rules.suggestedFix: pick a component whose dataType matrix includes this field's type

rules.title: Multiple editable inputs bind to the same field
rules.suggestedFix: keep only one editable input bound to each field — move extra inputs to a different field

rules.title: Duplicate bind in component tree
rules.suggestedFix: remove one of the duplicated binds — a single field MUST NOT be bound by more than one component in the same tree

rules.title: Signed-payload responseId does not match top-level Response id
rules.suggestedFix: set authoredSignatures[*].signedPayload.responseId to the top-level Response id, or correct the top-level id — the pin MUST match

rules.title: Signed-payload definitionUrl does not match top-level Response definitionUrl
rules.suggestedFix: set authoredSignatures[*].signedPayload.definitionUrl to the top-level Response definitionUrl — the pin MUST match

rules.title: Signed-payload definitionVersion does not match top-level Response definitionVersion
rules.suggestedFix: set authoredSignatures[*].signedPayload.definitionVersion to the top-level Response definitionVersion — the pin MUST match

rules.title: Invalid Mapping path syntax
rules.suggestedFix: fix the Mapping sourcePath, targetPath, defaults key, or projection source path to use the path syntax required by its source or target format

rules.title: Mapping FEL expression failed to parse
rules.suggestedFix: fix the Mapping expression, condition, or reverse.expression so it parses as FEL

rules.title: Mapping target write conflict
rules.suggestedFix: change the conflicting targetPath/default paths so one rule does not write a parent of another written path

rules.title: Mapping projection type contradicts enum
rules.suggestedFix: make projection.targetEnum values match projection.targetType, or remove the contradictory hint

rules.title: Mapping projection requiredness contradicts omission
rules.suggestedFix: do not mark an omitted/drop mapping projection as required, or set projection.emit true and map a target value

rules.title: Bidirectional Mapping lossy transform lacks reverse
rules.suggestedFix: add an explicit reverse block or set bidirectional to false for the lossy transform

rules.title: Bidirectional non-injective valueMap lacks reverse map
rules.suggestedFix: add reverse.valueMap for the non-injective valueMap.forward, or set bidirectional to false

rules.title: Duplicate Mapping target write
rules.suggestedFix: merge duplicate writes to the same targetPath or make overwrite ordering explicit in documentation

rules.title: Mapping non-static transform lacks projection hints
rules.suggestedFix: add projection.targetType or projection.targetEnum, or set projection.emit to false when the rule should not appear in static projections

rules.title: Mapping source path does not resolve
rules.suggestedFix: point sourcePath at an item path in the paired Definition or add the missing item

rules.title: Mapping inner rule source path does not resolve
rules.suggestedFix: make array.innerRules[*].sourcePath resolve relative to the active array item scope

rules.title: Mapping projection source path does not resolve
rules.suggestedFix: point projection.sourcePaths entries at Definition item paths or active array item paths

rules.title: Mapping projection requiredness contradicts Definition
rules.suggestedFix: align projection.required with Definition-derived requiredness, or remove the requiredness hint

rules.title: Mapping requiredness cannot be inferred statically
rules.suggestedFix: simplify the rule or add explicit projection.required only when the requiredness contract is intentional

rules.title: Invalid Ontology item path syntax
rules.suggestedFix: change the Ontology concepts key or alignment field to valid Formspec item-path syntax

rules.title: Ontology targetDefinition URL mismatch
rules.suggestedFix: set targetDefinition.url to the paired Definition url

rules.title: Ontology static value looks dynamic
rules.suggestedFix: replace FEL-looking Ontology static values with literal ontology metadata

rules.title: Ontology compatibleVersions mismatch
rules.suggestedFix: adjust targetDefinition.compatibleVersions so it includes the paired Definition version

rules.title: Ontology concept path unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: point the concepts key at an item path in the paired Definition

rules.title: Ontology alignment field unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: point alignments[*].field at an item path in the paired Definition

rules.title: Ontology vocabulary option set unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: rename the vocabulary key to match a Definition optionSets key

rules.title: Ontology vocabulary valueMap key unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: make vocabulary valueMap keys match option values in the referenced option set

rules.title: Ontology concept uses defaultSystem fallback
rules.suggestedFix: add an explicit concept system when defaultSystem fallback is not intended

rules.title: Ontology concept omits system with no defaultSystem
rules.suggestedFix: add system on the concept binding or define a document-level defaultSystem

rules.title: References $ref does not resolve
rules.suggestedFix: point references[*].$ref at an existing #/referenceDefs/{key} entry

rules.title: References id does not match referenceDefs key
rules.suggestedFix: make referenceDefs.{key}.id equal the map key, or remove the explicit id

rules.title: Duplicate authored reference id
rules.suggestedFix: rename one duplicate reference id; repeated $ref reuse is allowed but authored ids must be unique

rules.title: Invalid References target path
rules.suggestedFix: use # for form-level references or a valid Formspec item path for references[*].target

rules.title: References static field looks dynamic
rules.suggestedFix: replace FEL-looking Reference metadata with a static literal value

rules.title: Unknown References type
rules.suggestedFix: use a known References type or prefix custom types with x-

rules.title: Unknown References rel
rules.suggestedFix: use a known References rel or prefix custom relationship values with x-

rules.title: References targetDefinition URL mismatch
rules.suggestedFix: set targetDefinition.url to the paired Definition url

rules.title: References compatibleVersions mismatch
rules.suggestedFix: adjust targetDefinition.compatibleVersions so it includes the paired Definition version

rules.title: References target path unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: point references[*].target at an item path in the paired Definition, or use # for form-level references

rules.title: Locale targetDefinition URL mismatch
rules.suggestedFix: set targetDefinition.url to the paired Definition url

rules.title: Locale compatibleVersions mismatch
rules.suggestedFix: adjust targetDefinition.compatibleVersions so it includes the paired Definition version

rules.title: Invalid Locale string key namespace or terminal
rules.suggestedFix: change the string key to a supported Locale namespace and presentation terminal

rules.title: Locale item key unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: point the Locale item key at an item path in the paired Definition

rules.title: Locale option key unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: make Locale option or optionSet keys match Definition option values

rules.title: Locale shape key unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: point $shape keys at a shape id in the paired Definition

rules.title: Locale interpolation failed to parse
rules.suggestedFix: fix the FEL expression inside the Locale {{ }} interpolation

rules.title: Locale fallback cycle
rules.suggestedFix: break the locale fallback cycle by changing or removing one fallback

rules.title: Locale key targets non-presentation property
rules.suggestedFix: localize presentation text only; do not target data constraints or business-logic fields

rules.title: Locale page key unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: point $page keys at a page id in the supplied Theme document

rules.title: Locale component key unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: point $component keys at a node id in the supplied Component documents

rules.title: Locale fallback target not supplied
rules.suggestedFix: supply the fallback Locale document in lint context or remove the explicit fallback

rules.title: Screener bind path unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: point screener binds at screener item paths; screener binds do not resolve against external Definitions

rules.title: Screener phase or route graph is invalid
rules.suggestedFix: make phase ids unique and ensure each phase has a valid strategy and route list

rules.title: Screener conditional route missing condition
rules.suggestedFix: add condition to first-match, fan-out, and override routes

rules.title: Screener score-threshold route incomplete
rules.suggestedFix: add both score and threshold to score-threshold routes

rules.title: Screener route target is invalid
rules.suggestedFix: use outcome:name, url|version, a URI, or a relative URI target without whitespace

rules.title: Screener lifecycle metadata is inconsistent
rules.suggestedFix: make availability, resultValidity, and evaluationBinding metadata internally consistent

rules.title: Determination Record is inconsistent
rules.suggestedFix: align Determination Record status, overrides.halted, phases, and version fields

rules.title: Screener route message interpolation failed to parse
rules.suggestedFix: fix the FEL expression inside the Screener route message {{ }} interpolation

rules.title: Screener first-match route shadowed
rules.suggestedFix: move unconditional first-match routes after narrower routes or make the earlier condition selective

rules.title: Issuer kind and parentOrganization mismatch
rules.suggestedFix: add parentOrganization to department issuers, or remove parentOrganization from individual issuers

rules.title: Experience targetDefinition URL mismatch
rules.suggestedFix: set targetDefinition.url to the paired Definition url

rules.title: Experience compatibleVersions mismatch
rules.suggestedFix: adjust targetDefinition.compatibleVersions so it includes the paired Definition version

rules.title: Experience reference unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: make actorRef, actorRefs, and taskRefs values match ids declared in the Experience document

rules.title: Experience ItemRef path unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: point unit.itemRefs[].path at an item path in the paired Definition

rules.title: Experience required item uncovered
rules.suggestedFix: add a unit.itemRefs entry for every required visible Definition field

rules.title: Response Actions targetDefinition URL mismatch
rules.suggestedFix: set targetDefinition.url to the paired Definition url

rules.title: Response Actions compatibleVersions mismatch
rules.suggestedFix: adjust targetDefinition.compatibleVersions so it includes the paired Definition version

rules.title: Response Actions duplicate action id
rules.suggestedFix: make every actions[].id unique within the Response Actions document

rules.title: Component ActionButton actionRef unresolved
rules.suggestedFix: declare a matching Response Actions actions[].id or update the ActionButton actionRef

rules.title: VMAP-INVALID-OVERRIDE: Response Actions validation override violates the §6.3 permitted-tuple predicate
rules.suggestedFix: replace the per-action validation tuple with one that satisfies VM §6.3: complete-response requires (on-submit, block-on-error); block-on-error requires complete-response; off + block-on-error is forbidden

rules.title: Response Actions idempotencyKey lacks @-binding
rules.suggestedFix: use a FEL expression that references at least one @-binding (e.g., "@invocation.id & '/<effect-name>'") so the key varies per invocation; literal-string keys silently defeat idempotency by producing the same value for every attempt
